_comment: Data-quality rules for sensor observations. Validation only FLAGS records; it never deletes or edits them. 'basis' records where each number comes from. Values marked project-defined must be reviewed against pilot-farm data.

timestamp.min_valid_basis: Matches the app's NTP-failure rule (year < 2020) in Dashboard_Screen.dart; firmware sends 1970-01-01 when NTP fails.
timestamp.ingest_lag_basis: project-defined: device time vs Firestore create_time. Records marked buffered=true are exempt and get late_arrival instead.

gaps.expected_interval_basis: Code comment in Dashboard_Screen.dart ('pushes ... every 10s'); unverified against firmware.
gaps.basis: project-defined: gap > 3x interval = missed readings; gap > 5 min = device offline period.

dht_humidity_pct.sentinels_basis: app treats humidity <= 0 as no reading (Dashboard_Screen.dart)

amg_summary_c.impossible_basis: project-defined margin around AMG8833 datasheet object range 0..80 degC
amg_summary_c.sentinels_basis: app treats values <= 0 as no reading

amg_pixels_c.impossible_basis: same as amg_summary_c, applied per pixel

water_level_pct.stuck_basis: a constant tank level is normal

water_distance_cm.impossible_basis: HC-SR04 datasheet range 2..400 cm, with margin

sprinkler_active_s.impossible_basis: cannot be negative or longer than a day
sprinkler_active_s.plausible_basis: project-defined: one activation longer than 60 min is unusual
